feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, and no outcome is claimed for it. The Integrator kept the verified iteration 10 controller (kp 3.0, kd 0.2, last_direction) on the frozen iteration 9 and 10 geometry. Evidence: sensor spread (iterations 1, 8), footprint (iteration 2), wheel track (iterations 3, 9), wheel radius (iteration 4), lead (iteration 5, which matched iteration 0 exactly) and mass (iteration 7) all left max_error at 0.060 to 0.062 m and one line-loss event per trial on the oval and s-bend. The only changes that moved those tracks were controller changes: kp 3.0 (iteration 6) and kd 0.2 (iteration 10, progress 0.197 and 0.177). Mass 0.5 kg (iteration 7) lowered slalom oscillation to 0.1435 but also cut progress, so the score fell. If the next race matches iteration 10 to four decimals, geometry and controller are both at their verified values. If the oval or s-bend progress falls, the cause is in the controller, not the geometry. If slalom steering_oscillation stays above 0.16 with progress unchanged, mass 0.65 kg is the untested midpoint; it is a candidate only if a further race is ever run.
requested_changes: Keep the iteration 10 geometry (sensors at x = -0.04 to 0.04 m in 0.02 m steps, y = 0.07 m, 16 mm, wheel_track 0.10 m, mass 0.8 kg, wheel_radius 0.03 m, body 0.12 x 0.18 m) unchanged for the final race, because it is the verified best platform.

If slalom steering_oscillation stays above 0.16 at kd 0.2 with progress unchanged, test mass 0.65 kg on the same geometry, as the midpoint between the verified 0.8 kg and the 0.5 kg result that lost progress.
Do not spend a change on sensor spread, footprint, lead or body_width. Iterations 1, 2, 5 and 8 showed these leave the oval and s-bend at the baseline.
